response.title: which solar generator recharges fastest from solar panels in one day
response.answer:
If you're looking for the fastest solar generator to recharge using solar panels in a single day, the most important specification is its maximum solar input wattage, not its AC charging speed.

There are two ways to define fastest:

Fastest full recharge: Which generator can go from 0% to 100% in the fewest hours of sunlight?

Most solar energy collected per day: Which generator can absorb the most watt-hours of solar power during daylight?

These can produce very different winners. A 2,000Wh generator with 2,000W solar input can theoretically recharge in about an hour of peak sunlight, while a 10,000Wh system with 4,000W input takes much longer but stores far more energy.
